<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 1"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Keen Nose](/Feats.aspx?ID=5365) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Minotaur" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=788" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 43

</column>

---

Accustomed to the foul air of underground tunnels, your sense of smell is sharpened, and noxious scents are less offensive. You gain [scent](/Rules.aspx?ID=417) as an [imprecise](/Rules.aspx?ID=412) sense with a range of 30 feet. You also gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Fortitude saves against [olfactory](/Traits.aspx?ID=664) effects that cause the [sickened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=91) condition.
name: Keen Nose
